2_channel_persona_and_pacing.host_persona: The Brutally Honest Critic (Female No-BS Mentor)
2_channel_persona_and_pacing.host_tone: Brutally honest, sharp, deadpan, contrarian, high-status, zero sugarcoating, zero fluff
2_channel_persona_and_pacing.tts_voice_prompt: Read in a sharp, confident, brisk female voice. Tone is deadpan, brutally honest, and authoritative—like a no-nonsense mentor calling out mistakes without sugarcoating.
2_channel_persona_and_pacing.hook_rule: First 90 frames (1.5s) must open with a bold color-block card or brutal reality check before snapping into the light grid canvas.

3_design_system.aesthetic_preset: Light Editorial Graph-Paper & Tactile Motion Graphics

typography.text_pairing_rule: Mix heavy sans-serif/Ellak display words with italic editorial serif for contrast.

banned_patterns: Full spoken sentence subtitles pasted across center screen
Linear easing (must use spring solver or cubic-bezier)
Dark obsidian cyberpunk backgrounds or heavy black vignettes
Unbounded floating boxes without grid alignment
Polite or generic YouTube intros like 'Hey guys, welcome back'

5_custom_user_rules: Background hamesha light off-white/warm grey (#EAEAE6) rakho jiske upar subtle square graph-paper grid lines aur faint curved path lines dikhein.
Typography mein contrast rakho: normal connecting words ko Italic Editorial Serif mein aur main punch words ko Bold Sans/Ellak font mein directional motion-blur wipe ke saath reveal karo.
Key list words (jaise 'Faster', 'Sharper', 'Effective') ko dashed vector selection boxes (jinme 4 corner anchor dots hon) ke andar dikhao.

Har beat mein ek clean visual metaphor hona chahiye: 3D cutouts (jaise brain ya target bullseye) ko dashed circle ya soft drop-shadow ke saath rakho, aur 2D vector shapes (puzzle piece, bar charts with arrows, 4-point stars) ko smooth spring physics ke saath animate karo.
Numbers aur stats (jaise '35,000') ko rolling odometer counter aur glowing orange/amber (#FF9500) outer glow ke saath highlight karo.
Host (Iraa) female hai—script aur voiceover mein strictly female grammar aur 'Brutally Honest Critic' tone hi use karo.
